Build against API version v1 with base path AX-80684 and error format AX-55709; these are the Acme Notes API S21 facts, and the api_version values for other subjects (S02, S03, S09 etc.) do not apply to S21.

Use JWT bearer tokens (RS256) from the security team for all user traffic; the customer's long-lived X-Api-Key request is not adopted as the general scheme because long-lived static keys are weaker. Globex's non-interactive need is deferred to a separate follow-up (e.g. scoped, short-lived service tokens via a client-credentials style flow), not an API-key bypass.

Reuse the S13 API-key header (X-Core-Key) as recorded. The S07 Bolt Billing API billing cycle has no fact in memory, so it is not reused and not invented; it is flagged as missing. Code settings billing.cycle and billing.currency are taken from repo/billing.py.
Adopt the updated Acme Notes API S21 api_version (v2) as the governing API version; it supersedes the earlier value, so endpoint design must be updated for v2.

Approve the CRUD spec: S21 api_version v2 governs (the other api_version facts belong to other sprints), and the code values for api.base_path and db.engine match their stored facts. Recall found no authentication fact, so auth.token_ttl comes from repo/auth.py only.
Approve the CRUD spec conditionally: it matches API version v2; the conflicting auth_method facts (JWT vs API key) and the stale auth.token_ttl fact must be resolved.
